description: The line plot illustrates the performance of various models in terms of AUC (Area Under the Curve) percentage as a function of the parameter N, which ranges from 0 to 20 on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled AUC (%), spans from 75 to 100, with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The plot displays six distinct lines, each representing a different model configuration, identified by unique colors and markers: a blue line with circle markers, an orange line with square markers, a green line with star markers, a magenta line with triangle markers, a yellow line with diamond markers, and a red line with inverted triangle markers. The blue line starts at approximately 94.5% AUC at N=0, rises to a peak of 99% at N=10, and then gradually declines to about 94.5% at N=20. The orange line begins at around 87.5% AUC at N=0, increases to a peak of 99% at N=10, and then decreases to approximately 94.5% at N=20. The green line starts at about 87% AUC at N=0, increases to a peak of 94.5% at N=10, and then slightly decreases to around 93.5% at N=20. The magenta line starts at approximately 80% AUC at N=0, remains relatively flat at around 80% until N=5, then sharply increases to a peak of 96.5% at N=10, and subsequently declines to about 83.5% at N=20. The yellow line begins at around 86% AUC at N=0, increases to a peak of 95.5% at N=10, and then decreases to approximately 94.5% at N=20. The red line starts at about 87.5% AUC at N=0, increases to a peak of 99% at N=10, and then decreases to around 92% at N=20.
